highlights.excerpt:
A little something that's not mentioned, and ppl may not even think about:

Binance did not borrow money
Binance did not sell assets
Binance did not raise money

Binance covered from its balance sheet.

This differs from other incidents that people keep wanting to compare to. 🙏

很少有人提、甚至想不到的一点：

币安没有借钱
币安没有卖资产
币安没有融资

损失由自有资产负债表覆盖。

这与大家总想拿来对比的其他事件不同。🙏
